(Simultaneous Dimensional Gateway)

label: Nathan
description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
After obtaining the hard drive in the main quest, open his cage using 3 numbers found around the map in this order: Interrogation Rooms, Food Hall, Engineering.
Once entered you'll need to open the cage all at the same time if playing with multiple players.

label: Peck & Strauss
description:
Can be interacted with to complete the code for the resonator for 5000 essence.
Must also be interacted with in order to find Nathan after obtaining the Hard Drive.
Finally, they will provide the Hacking Device after completing the rewiring step.

label: Torn Paper #1
description: This page tells you the first Point of Power trap that needs to be completed, make a note of it if you'd like to avoid the wall step. Can be found around the hallway area.

label: Stamp
description: Used to unlock any of the 4 bastard swords from their pedestals.

label: The Lion
description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to kill a glowing parasite (4 of them spawn upon picking up the sword for the first time), bring the glow that will appear on your sword, and hit the lion door, located in the town with it.

label: The Dragon
description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to take the sword to the dragon statue at the top of the stairs by the castle entrance.

label: The Raven
description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to find a statue in the Alchemical Lab with an animal part. Then head to the pub basement.

label: The Stag
description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to find all 3 lighting rods, place them in the container and complete a lockdown.

label: Upgrade - The Lion
description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
A door with a lion emblem. Once your sword is glowing from killing a glowing parasite, hit this door with it to light up 1 of 4 sybmols. After doing all 4, interact with the door to start a lockdown. Once inside place the sword in the pedestal and shoot 4 hovering symbols that appear in the order they light up on the pedestal.

label: Upgrade - The Dragon
description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
After placing the sword in the statue, bring 3 flames from brasiers around the map, back to the statue. You can melee zombies to regain health

label: Upgrade - The Raven
description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
Find the circular puzzle. Place the antiquity that you picked up, then place the sword. Figure out the zodiac symbol and Aristotelian element that represents the antiquity, then align the 2 correct sybmbols. After doing this you will need to guide orbs into portals 3 times.

description:
Paladin's Brooch
Obtained by shooting each red crystal light along the walls, starting with the one above the fireplace in the dining room. Aim the light beam at the next one, by shooting it from the left or right side of each crystal.

label: Ritual Item - The Dragon
description:
Ankh Charm
You must ignite 3 wood bundles and kill a Doppelghast to drop this item. It has no fixed location.

label: Ritual Item Step - The Dragon
description:
Wood Bundle
Needs to be ignited using any source of fire e.g. molotov, fire sword, incendiary. Once all 3 are lit, a Doppelghast will spawn, kill it to obtain the Ankh Charm

Obtained by taking the sewer exit from the castle and shooting the Raven in the tunnel. Once out of the pipe, shoot the raven in the sky for it to drop it's talon.

label: Ritual Item Step - The Stag
description:
Otto's Horseshoe
Shoot it from above the doorframe in the barn by deadshot.

label: Ritual Item - The Stag
description:
Pegasus's Horseshoe
After obtaining Otto's Horseshoe, fire yourself from the cannon to spawn, then look in the air for a stormcloud. The horseshoe will appear beneath it.

label: Symbol Wall
description: When punched with Melee Macchiato it reveals a wall of symbols that must be shot in the corresponding order to symbols shown on the bottles in the pub that appear after talking to Kraft. After the sequence is complete, it reveals a book to the left that allows you to place the torn pages found in the common room.

label: Secret Study
description:
The door is revealed after activating and completing all point of power traps, in the correct order as shown in the book next to the symbol wall.
The wall can only be opened after obtaining the Mystic Orb

label: Mystic Orb
description: Is required to open the Secret Study. To spawn it, in the order as noted on the Secret Study Door (Clockwise from the top), perform a weapon inspect with the matching sword in front of the matching statue, then activate the appropriate incantation on the same statue. When done correctly the statue will light up yellow. After the 4th statue is done the Orb will spawn.

label: Orb Pedestal - The Lion
description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, run to each large green orb as fast as possible to charge the orb, no killing is necessary, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

label: Orb Pedestal - The Dragon
description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with any fire damage including the alt fire of the Dragon sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

label: Orb Pedestal - The Raven
description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with shadow rift effects, including Kazimir devices and the alt fire of the Raven sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

label: Orb Pedestal - The Stag
description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with any electrical effect, including the alt fire of the Stag sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

label: Guardian Key
description: Found after opening the Study door with the charged orb by performing all 4 orb rituals. This recording can be activated and collected in order to begin the bossfight, back at spawn.

label: Boss Fight
description: A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.

label: Tombs Mural
description: First obtain the monocle from the first shock mimic. Then shoot aetheric lanterns (and wait for them to respawn) until one is opposite the mural on the left side. Then shoot the lit symbols in order (roman numerals) to trigger a lockdown. The reward is 1 of 2 ice staff parts.

label: Caves Mural
description: First obtain the monocle from the first shock mimic. Then shoot aetheric lanterns (and wait for them to respawn) until one is opposite the mural. Then shoot the lit symbols in order (roman numerals) to trigger a lockdown. The reward is 1 of 2 ice staff parts.

label: Nexus Altar
description: Take the ice staff parts here and interact with it to trigger a defend event. Stop the staff being destroyed and you'll earn the base ice staff.

label: Floating Rocks
description: Shoot 3 aetheric lanterns within 10 seconds of eachother, with the ice staff, then enter the dark aether and look up to see 3 rocks with symbols on them. Shoot them with the staff to lower them, make a note of the symbols.

label: Purple Orb
description: After the floating rocks are lowered, one of the doors will close off. Go to the other side of the door and shoot the 3 symbols that were on the rocks. If you do it correctly the door will reopen and the 3 symbols will glow on the floor of the door. After entering you'll be dropped on top of the floating rock with the purple orb. Interact with it to trigger a moving soul box, move it by killing nearby the orb, when it ends interact with the alter and the ice staff will be upgraded.

label: Vermin Crystal
description: The pillar needs to be charged by completing a trial associated with the statue in front of it. Each statue will have a coloured crystal appear one after another, they can be initiated by shooting the crystal with the healing beam (alt fire) from the upgraded ice staff. The colour corresponds to the door where you can find the podium for the trial. The first one is blue/vermin.

label: Vermin Podium
description:
This is the podium associated with the one in the dark aether. Each will have a statue of the special enemy associated with it. After completing the lockdown you need to take the energy from the podium back to the associated pillar in the aether. Try not to get hit.
Located in Dig Site.

label: Parasite Crystal
description: The pillar needs to be charged by completing a trial associated with the statue in front of it. Each statue will have a coloured crystal appear one after another, they can be initiated by shooting the crystal with the healing beam (alt fire) from the upgraded ice staff. The colour corresponds to the door where you can find the podium for the trial. The first one is blue/vermin.

label: Parasite Podium
description:
This is the podium associated with the one in the dark aether. Each will have a statue of the special enemy associated with it. After completing the lockdown you need to take the energy from the podium back to the associated pillar in the aether. Try not to get hit.
Purple energy will infect the parasites. Kill them and bring the energy balls back to the podium to charge it.

label: Doppelghast Crystal
description: The pillar needs to be charged by completing a trial associated with the statue in front of it. Each statue will have a coloured crystal appear one after another, they can be initiated by shooting the crystal with the healing beam (alt fire) from the upgraded ice staff. The colour corresponds to the door where you can find the podium for the trial. The first one is blue/vermin.

label: Doppelghast Podium
description:

Spawns lasers and purple explosions that you should avoid.

description: The pillar needs to be charged by completing a trial associated with the statue in front of it. Spawns a single elite amalgam, when he has a bubble around him you should kill the tethered zombie first before you can continue dealing damage.

label: Boss Fight
description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
The bridge will open up after the last step. Cross it and interact with the artifact to start the fight.

label: Elevator Fuse

label: Elevator Circuit Board

label: Elevator

label: Hidden Vault
description: The door to the vault that will open after collecting the 3 blue aether books and activating them in the correct order, indicated by the order of books in the yellow liminal space.

label: Yellow Ritual
description: After obtaining the Nuclear Plant Inspection Report, return here to start a mini bossfight that requires the Yellow Mk2 R to beat the boss and complete 1 of 3 rituals.

label: Blue Mk2 W Canister
description: Break blue crystals/rocks around the map with the Ray Gun Mk2 to retrieve the canister.

label: Blue Crystal
description:
1 of 4 total crystals around the map, visible with death perception, that can be shot with the Ray Gun Mk2 and will drop scrap and one of them will drop the canister needed for one of the Mk2 W Upgrade.
Conservatory Roof.

description: Use the sconce to start the Simon Says puzzle and access the Distillery.

label: Blue Distillery Liminal Space
description: Open the liminal space by interacting with the machine to the left, then kill zombies with the Blue Mk2 W near it, to open it.

label: Blue Ritual

label: Reflector

description: Used in the serpent mount puzzle, found in dried up fountains around the map.

label: Banquet Hall Liminal Space
description: Open the liminal space by interacting with the machine to the left, then kill zombies with the Purple Mk2 P. Then retrieve the code for the antler carving from the safe in West Hallway by completing the chalice rituals and returning to the area around the elevator.

label: Ritual Chalice
description:
1 of 3 total chalices around the map, that can be interacted with after obtaining the Ritual Elixir from the Purple Banquet Hall liminal space.
On the stone bench at spawn.

Fight S.A.M (easier)
Target weak points after laser attacks and spinning volleys.

If helping S.A.M:
Fight Uber Richtofen (harder)

Phase 2: Use Aether Shroud.
